text: “我一直觉得，伴侣的好绝不在于他在普世价值中表现出来的那些。
en: I have always felt that what is good about a partner is never those things he shows in line with universal values.

text: 让女生走马路内侧，轻声说话，制造浪漫之类。
en: Letting the girl walk on the inside of the road, speaking softly, creating romance, and the like.

text: 我喜欢的，是一个正常人灵魂里躲着的神经病，是一个智者脑子中存在的白痴，是一朵玫瑰脚下的泥土，是宇宙里最特别的那颗星，是只被我看见的那部分天真。
en: What I like is the madman hiding in the soul of an ordinary person, the fool existing in the mind of a wise man, the soil beneath a rose, the most special star in the universe, and the part of innocence seen only by me.

text: ——网易云音乐热评《Star of the county down》（作者ID：庭有枇杷树啊）
en: ——NetEase Cloud Music hot comment on 'Star of the county down' (Author ID: Ting You Pipa Shu A)

text: 当时看到问题就想到了这段话，所以就回答了，也没想到会有这么多人赞同，当然也有质疑。
en: When I saw the question at the time, this passage came to mind, so I answered, never expecting so many people to agree, though of course there were doubts as well.

text: 毕竟答主是女生，相对男生是站在另一个角度，可以说是我们女生眼中的男生是什么样的。
en: After all, the answerer is a girl, and relative to boys stands at another angle; one could say it is what boys look like in the eyes of us girls.

text: 从问题本身来说，男生真实的一面有很多，他可以成熟稳重，也可以天真可爱，更可以是虚伪好色。
en: Speaking of the question itself, boys have many real sides: he can be mature and steady, or innocent and adorable, or even hypocritical and lustful.

text: 天真不是真实的一面吗？
en: Is innocence not a real side?

text: 成熟就不真实了吗？
en: Is maturity then not real?

text: 这里并没有否定。
en: There is no denial being made here.

text: 真实的一面怎么可能说全？
en: How could one ever describe all of one's real sides?

text: 人在不同的情况下会有不同的一面。
en: People show different sides in different situations.

text: 从这段话本身来看，文字很美很有诗意，与现实的残酷相比，让人觉得不真实。
en: Looking at this passage itself, the words are beautiful and poetic, and compared with the cruelty of reality they feel unreal.

text: 但其实智者也好，玫瑰也罢，还是宇宙最亮的那颗星，都可以是看做美好的一面。
en: But in fact, whether a wise man, a rose, or the brightest star in the universe, all can be seen as the beautiful side.

text: 但是不论是白痴，还是脚下的泥土，不美好也是一种真实，是接近现实的真实。
en: Yet whether it is the fool or the soil beneath one's feet, the not-beautiful is also a kind of reality, a reality close to the real world.

text: 大部分人喜欢你，他们就想普普通通地喜欢你一下，和你在一起。
en: Most people who like you simply want to like you in an ordinary way, and to be with you.

text: 摸摸你的叶子，亲亲你开的花。
en: Touch your leaves, kiss the flowers you bloom.

text: 这时候你不能把地下盘根错节的根系都拔起，放到天光之下，放到他面前，说：你看一看吧，求求你连它们一起爱我，这才是我本来的样子呀。
en: At this point you cannot pull up the tangled root system underground, bring it into the daylight, place it before him and say: take a look, please love me together with them, this is what I am really like.

text: 很遗憾，你就是不能这么做。
en: Regrettably, you simply cannot do this.

text: 而我就喜欢这么做，
en: Yet I like to do exactly this,

text: 这个是我在别处抄的，一直在我备忘录里面挂着，没想到这么多人赞。
en: This I copied from somewhere else, and it has been hanging in my memos; I never expected so many people to like it.

text: 开始不太记得是谁的原创，就没写原著名。
en: At first I did not quite remember whose original work it was, so I did not write the name of the original.

text: 以下是一个小姐姐的评论感觉很有价值就征得本人同意放了上来。
en: Below is a comment from a young lady which I felt was valuable, so with her consent I have put it up here.

text: 总之希望每一个人都能找到合适自己的另一半。
en: In short, I hope everyone can find the other half that suits them.

text: 新加了一段，这段话用最朴实无华的语言解释出了我们展露自己最差的一面的原因，希望每一个人都能参与到爱情这一件伟大的事情上。
en: I have added a new passage; with the most plain and unadorned language it explains the reason we reveal our worst side, and I hope everyone can take part in the great affair that is love.

text: 给你指条明路：男人这玩意儿太简单了！
en: Let me point you to a clear path: men are just too simple!

text: 男人对你冷淡对你不管不问，那就是看不上你的表现，觉得自己牛批了，能找到更好的了。
en: When a man is cold to you and ignores you, that is the sign he looks down on you, thinks he is brilliant, and believes he can find someone better.

text: 你只要就坡下驴断崖式消失让他去找，只有他自己去碰壁，被拒绝，他才知道自己几斤几两。
en: You only need to take the opportunity to disappear off a cliff and let him go looking; only when he himself hits walls and is rejected will he learn his own true measure.

text: 绝大部分男人的普信都是被你们惯的，放他们回人海真的啥也不是。
en: The universal confidence of the vast majority of men is spoilt into them by you; send them back into the sea of people and they are really nothing at all.

text: 不要怕断联，他哪那么容易找到好的。
en: Do not fear going no-contact; how could he so easily find someone good.

text: 他命咋就这么好，碰到你一个好的后面还能碰到好的。
en: How is his luck so good, that after meeting you, a good one, he can still meet another good one.

text: 如果他能找到好的，不断联人家也会找到。
en: If he can find a good one, even without going no-contact he would find one.

text: 如果找不到好的，只要他回头。
en: If he cannot find a good one, he only needs to turn back.

text: 请给我往里虐他。
en: Please, torment him all the more.

text: 说明啥？
en: What does this show?

text: 说明你是他天板了！
en: It shows you are his ceiling!

text: 以下这几点务必记住。
en: The following points must be remembered.

text: 1、一定增加他的沉没城本，让他有诚意的追求你，太容易得到的不会珍惜，对他冷淡，接受他的好，不答应复合，不给碰，花他的钱。
en: 1. Be sure to increase his sunk cost, so that he pursues you with sincerity; what comes too easily will not be cherished. Be cold to him, accept his kindness, do not agree to get back together, do not let him touch you, and spend his money.

text: 信我的，你这么虐过他，你就是他永远刻骨铭心的白月光。
en: Trust me, once you have tormented him like this, you become his forever unforgettable white moonlight.

text: 2、请以男人的方式来“爱”他们。
en: 2. Please 'love' them in the way men do.

text: 男人想要的爱是什么样的呢？
en: What kind of love do men want?

text: 轻薄舒适。
en: Light, thin and comfortable.

text: 想象一下你最喜欢的那款姨妈巾，柔软、轻薄、不闷气、不敏感、神仙肤感、包容度高、完美贴合身体舒适又安心。
en: Imagine your favourite sanitary pad: soft, light, thin, breathable, non-irritating, a heavenly skin feel, high tolerance, perfectly fitting the body, comfortable and reassuring.

text: 如果同时大品牌、高颜值、方便携带，就是最好的选择了。
en: If at the same time it is a big brand, good-looking, and easy to carry, then it is the best choice.

text: 你们怎么选姨妈巾，男人就怎么选女人。
en: The way you choose a sanitary pad is the way men choose a woman.

text: 3、男人热恋期喜欢抓着女人疯狂探索，等起立不动了，就不喜欢女人跟他太黏腻了。
en: 3. During the passionate phase men like to grab women and explore wildly; once they stand up and go still, they no longer like women being too clingy with them.

text: 对他太上头，太关心，关心他的衣食住行，在他的眼里变成了查岗和监视，一点空间都没有，让他觉得在兄弟面前特别没面子。
en: Being too obsessed with him, too concerned, caring about his food, clothing, shelter and travel, turns in his eyes into checking up on him and surveillance; with no space at all, he feels especially humiliated in front of his mates.

text: 大酒约不了了，游戏玩不了了，偶尔翻翻小网站也要看看有没有被你发现。
en: He can no longer go on big drinking sessions, cannot play games, and even when he occasionally browses little websites he has to check whether you have found out.

text: 放纵成了奢望，严重的失去人身自由。
en: Indulgence becomes a luxury, and in serious cases he loses his personal freedom.

text: 4、他们就这么不知好歹，把爱理解成负担，把关心解读成管束，把原本美好的一切，定义为沉重。
en: 4. They are just so ungrateful, understanding love as a burden, reading care as control, and defining everything that was originally beautiful as heavy.

text: 而且女人从变得黏人开始，吸引力骤降。
en: Moreover, from the moment a woman becomes clingy, her appeal drops sharply.

text: 男人一旦捕获到你对他的极度需要，就会自信心爆棚，丧失对你的好奇心和求知欲，跟你蹬鼻子上脸，还能给你弄几个竞争者出来遛遛。
en: Once a man catches that you desperately need him, his self-confidence balloons, he loses his curiosity and thirst for knowledge about you, rides roughshod over you, and can even produce a few rivals to parade around.

text: 尤其是本来就不那么喜欢你，只想和你短期探索大自然奥秘的男人，你对他的重视会让他身心不健康，甚至不敢举不能举，连生物课也上不了。
en: Especially men who never liked you that much and only wanted to explore the mysteries of nature with you short-term; your valuing of him will make him physically and mentally unwell, even unable to rise to the occasion, unable to perform, and unable to attend biology class.

text: 在感情里，人性本贱。
en: In matters of the heart, human nature is base.

text: 5、男人爱的就是女人不爱自己的样子。
en: 5. What men love is the woman who does not love herself.

text: 一个不爱自己的女人，活得精彩恣意，从来不会主动找自己，也不会借着关心之名多看自己几眼，更不会想着办法骗他上床，在男人眼里充满了魅力，也充分激发了他们的挑战欲。
en: A woman who does not love herself lives brilliantly and freely, never takes the initiative to find him, never uses the pretext of care to sneak a few extra looks at him, and never schemes to trick him into bed; in men's eyes she is full of charm and fully stirs their desire for a challenge.

text: 6、跟男人相处很简单的，每个月有那么几天爱他就行。
en: 6. Getting along with men is very simple: just love him those few days each month.

text: 其余时间，爱自己，关心自己，努力上进，握大把资产，圈一打追求者。
en: The rest of the time, love yourself, care for yourself, strive to improve, hold a great deal of assets, and keep a dozen suitors in your circle.

text: 实在没事干，把钱取出来，数，贴在墙上，铺在地上，叠飞机，堆乐高。
en: If you truly have nothing to do, take the money out, count it, stick it on the wall, spread it on the floor, fold it into planes, build it into Lego.

text: 7、对于他，无条件成全，咱啥也不用问，啥也不用想，遇到也装不认识。
en: 7. Towards him, unconditional fulfilment; we need not ask anything, need not think anything, and if we meet we pretend not to know him.

text: 不要，我就不给呗。
en: If not wanted, I just will not give it, that's all.

text: 他对你好，你就大方收下，他应付你，你就应付他他要走，你比他走得更快。
en: If he is good to you, accept it generously; if he fobs you off, you fob him off; if he wants to leave, you walk away faster than he does.

text: 8、故事的结局只有一个，当他把一个掏心肺，真心为了这段关系的女人伤得很深的时候，他自己会惨得连条狗都不如。
en: 8. The ending of the story is only one: when he has hurt a woman who poured out her heart and was truly devoted to this relationship so deeply, he himself will be miserably worse than a dog.

text: 得到你的时候有多不珍惜，失去你的时候就有多悔恨。
en: He cherished you so little when he had you, and regrets so much now that he has lost you.

text: 不过悔恨又怎么样？
en: But what of regret?

text: 各位别点赞了。
en: Everyone, stop liking this.

text: 他最近脾气又上来了，我感觉以前所做的努力都白费了。
en: His temper has flared up again recently, and I feel all the effort I made before was in vain.

text: 我更改我的答案：性格的东西其实很难改，婚前有就尽量接受，不接受就不要在一起，不要想着婚后可以改造。
en: I am changing my answer: things of character are truly hard to change; if they are there before marriage, accept them as much as possible; if you cannot accept them, do not be together; do not think you can remould them after marriage.

text: sorry，我现在把原答案给删除了。
en: sorry, I have now deleted the original answer.
